newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal, German bond spread narrows to record low.
newsitem.headline: Portugal, German bond spread narrows to record low.

text.p: The spread between the benchmark Portuguese 10-year cash bond and the German bund narrowed on Friday to a historic low of 110 basis points as Portuguese bonds rose on news that the European Union had reached a deal on enforcing budget discipline, dealers said.
"The agreement (on the stability pact) triggered this rise in the OT (Portuguese bonds) and narrowed the spread (with bunds)," said one trader.

Traders said that with Spain exceptionally strong, the spread between the Iberian market's 10-year cash bond would probably disappear because of the relative lack of liquidity of the Portuguese market.
"We are going to end up flat with Spain. But if they go to 100 basis points (to the bunds), we will go with them," said another trader.
